title: Blank Input Reads Occur at the Boundaries
statement: Let $x$ be a word over any alphabet and let $c$ be a configuration on $x$. The input head reads no symbol if and only if its position is $0$ or $|x|+1$.
hypotheses_covered: Alphabet A and state set S
Natural number k of work tapes
replaced:
For any configuration of a multi-tape machine on an input word $x$, the input
read is blank if and only if the input head is at position $0$ or at position
$|x| + 1$.
